title: Julia Chevan
text:
Hi, I am Julia. I am a physical therapist, health services researcher, and public health professional with more than 30 years of experience at the intersection of academia, rehabilitation, implementation science, and chronic disease prevention.
I am a faculty member with the Clinical Research PhD Program at the University of Jamestown.
I also engage in public health work as a subject matter expert working with the National Association of Chronic Disease Directors. My public health work focuses on building models for community-clinical partnerships that improve outcomes for people living with arthritis, fall risk, and other chronic conditions.


What You’ll Find on My Website
Use that left navigation sidebar to explore these sections further

 Bio is where you’ll find the professional achievements in one spot. You wanna see a CV? I’ve got one posted and maybe even updated.
 Projects click if you are curious about my current projects and the labs I’m associated with as well as a few artifacts from public health initiatives developed through my work at NACDD.
 In Vivo honestly, this is all the really cool stuff (yes, my non-academic interests).
